entities.name: Paul Wilhelm, Duke of Württemberg
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Duke Friedrich Paul Wilhelm of Württemberg was a member of the House of Württemberg and a Duke of Württemberg. Paul Wilhelm was a German naturalist and explorer, who in the early 19th century, undertook several expeditions in North America, North Africa, and Australia. In 1829, he discovered the sources of the Missouri River.
